data.notes: Berlin’s December 2026 calendar is already led by arena-scale German pop/hip-hop tours and seasonal concert runs, while most club lineups are not yet announced this far out.

events.title: SIDOs Weihnachtsshow 2026
events.summary: Sido returns to Columbiahalle with his long-running Christmas show format, advertised by the venue as a festive evening with surprise guests from music and entertainment. The 2 December date is one of the confirmed 2026 performances listed by Columbiahalle.

events.title: PUR 2026
events.summary: German pop band PUR open their 2026 arena tour at Uber Arena Berlin on 2 December 2026. The official artist site lists the Berlin date and ticket link.

events.title: Sarah Brightman: A Winter Symphony
events.summary: Sarah Brightman brings her seasonal “A Winter Symphony” program to Tempodrom on 2 December 2026, with Tonči Huljić listed as support. The venue page confirms doors and start time for the Große Arena.

events.title: BAP: Fünfzig Jahre – Die Zielgerade Tour 2026
events.summary: Wolfgang Niedecken’s BAP play Uber Arena on 8 December 2026 as part of the band’s 50th-anniversary tour. The arena’s official event page confirms the date and tour title.

events.title: INNA: Echoes Tour 2026
events.summary: Romanian dance-pop artist INNA brings the Echoes Tour to Uber Eats Music Hall on 11 December 2026. The official venue page highlights her EDM, house and dance hits.

events.title: NIMO: Home Sweet Home Arena Tour 2026
events.summary: German rapper Nimo plays Velodrom Berlin on 12 December 2026 on his Home Sweet Home Arena Tour. Velodrom describes the Berlin stop as part of a double-header in December.

events.title: Jerome Froese: Rare Up Close – Live
events.summary: Jerome Froese performs at Privatclub on 12 December 2026, with the venue billing the show as electronic/guitartronica. The program includes solo work, reinterpreted Tangerine Dream material and new music.

events.title: Die Fantastischen Vier: Der letzte Bus – Final Tour
events.summary: German hip-hop pioneers Die Fantastischen Vier play Uber Arena Berlin on 17 December 2026. The official venue page lists the show as part of their final tour.

events.title: No Angels: It’s Christmas – Live in Berlin 2026
events.summary: No Angels celebrate their Christmas album with an exclusive Berlin concert at Uber Eats Music Hall on 18 December 2026. The venue page confirms the date, doors and start time.

events.title: Northern Lite: Christmas Show
events.summary: Northern Lite’s Christmas Show is listed by Astra Kulturhaus for 19 December 2026. The venue schedule confirms the Saturday date, doors and 19:00 start.

events.title: Grobes Fest 2026: Slime + Focus. + Rantanplan + Knochenfabrik
events.summary: Grobes Fest brings Slime, Focus., Rantanplan and Knochenfabrik to Astra Kulturhaus on 28 December 2026. Eventim’s listing confirms the Berlin date, venue and lineup.

events.title: Matthias Reim: 35 Jahre “Verdammt, ich lieb’ dich”
events.summary: Matthias Reim visits Uber Arena on 28 December 2026 on his anniversary tour for “Verdammt, ich lieb’ dich.” The arena’s official page confirms the date and tour context.
